reviews.text: Unfortunately they don’t accept any dogs that are a pitbull mix. My dog is a dachshund/pitty and I was hoping to find a daycare for her while I’m at the office. She’s less than 25 lbs with lil legs but based on pictures they said no. No temperament appt or meeting her in person.

They sent a professional pet groomer directly to my home, who was equipped with everything needed for the service. I believe pets are much more comfortable being groomed in their own familiar environment than going somewhere unfamiliar. The groomer was skilled and polite, provided excellent bathing and grooming services for my dog, and the overall experience was convenient and stress-free.

Bone Sweet Bone provides a loving and safe environment for dogs while their owners are away. Many pet owners praise the attentive and friendly staff who ensure dogs enjoy plenty of playtime, socialization, and personalized care in a cage‑free, home‑like setting. Their grooming and boarding services help dogs look and feel their best, and the boutique selection of premium pet supplies is a bonus. The team’s dedication to making every dog comfortable and happy gives owners peace of mind.
I can never tell where the pricing falls (i.e., under market value or above) but its so worth it. My doggy always comes back looking perfect and he seems to enjoy it. Lol

I recently dropped off my dog at Bone Sweet Bone, and I ended up really impressed. From the moment we walked in, the staff made him feel safe and welcome — lots of play space, friendly faces, and a bright, clean environment. They offer a solid range of services: daycare, overnight stays, “late nights,” plus grooming and a cute little Bark Boutique with quality pet products. What stood out was how much they focus on playtime—my pup got plenty of social time, not just cage time. The team also gave me thoughtful advice on nutrition and care. Pickup and drop-off were smooth, and I got a detailed update on how my dog did during his stay. It’s obvious they genuinely care about the dogs, and now I feel totally comfortable leaving him there. Highly recommend for any dog owner looking for a trustworthy, loving place.

I'm able to get early grooming appointments for my Charlie. I really appreciate being able to drop him off before going to work. I'm happy with how well Charlie is cared for. Since bringing him to Bone Sweet Bone, he has not had ear infections due to water getting into his ears. They do a really good job of protecting his ears by putting enough cotton on them. This may not sound like a big deal, but it is to me since Vet visits due to ear infections can be pricey.

I’m so mad after their grooming service.
The back side of head is so flat. It’s not even close.
I asked them trim a little bit but they texted me Kevin(my dog’s name) is matted and cut down little shorter and turned out they shaved Kevin.
Kevin is a bichon and I would pay extra dematting cost. They didn’t even ask me. They noticed me afterwards.
It’s not only poor grooming but also horrible service.
Look at my dog.

We're pleased with your five-star rating! Feel free to reach out if you need further assistance.

Bone Sweet Bone

Listen to the rest of the reviews and DO NOT take your dog here for grooming.
1. They cut her nails way too short to the point the part of the nail that shouldn’t have been cut is literally sticking out. She cried in pain with the slightest touch to her nails. Clear they messed it up - very evident just looking at it.

2. They then argue with you and make you feel stupid by saying there was no accident or bleeding. Not an accident, your untrained groomer messed up badly. Not my first dog or grooming. Literally Petco does a 100% better job. Not that hard to admit they made a mistake.

3. 0 liability - so called manager was going to contact me? Never happened lol? Why isn’t the manager there in the middle of a workday and why is not one ever at reception?

4 -aside from the insane attitude ( which they shouldn’t have a right to have at all lol) their response was we will cover vet bill and take your dog to vet. Excuse me??

5 - my dog was screaming, freaked out and unresponsive to food or treats. Never happened before at any grooming session at any place. Clearly they’re aggressive or just aren’t trained enough to handle dogs. Maybe their daycare is better but after this it’s hard to trust them

Stay away and keep your dog safe. Untrained, unprofessional and impeccably rude.
